free_tier.stated: Free WireGuard VPN servers in the US, UK, Canada, Germany and France. Generate a WireGuard config file or QR code in seconds, no signup. Configs last 7 days.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a tunnel or an address, not an object

retention.stated: not applicable: a live tunnel, not stored bytes

egress.terms: The page states no traffic allowance in either direction; it advertises no signup and no account, and is funded by ads and donations.; ingress: none

interface_detail: Web form generating a .conf or QR code.
tooling: wg-quick or the official WireGuard app importing the generated .conf.
chaining: A free client-side tunnel that composes with nothing inbound; useful for outbound fetches only.

limits.value: configs expire after 7 days: Configurations auto-expire after 7 days for security.
no port forwarding: nothing on the page offers an inbound port, and the servers are shared by an unknown number of users

binding_note: Volume is not metered and no identity is demanded, so the failure is the missing inbound path: there is no port to reach a service on.

identity_cost.detail: No account at all: no signup, config generated on the page.

reliability_note: Shared servers with unknown load, 7-day config expiry, and no stated abuse tolerance; UDP only, so networks that block UDP cannot use it.
confidence_note: The free config and its 7-day expiry are the vendor's own statements read today. The 1 TiB/month question is unanswerable from the page, so volume is left null rather than assumed unlimited.

evidence.proved: Free WireGuard configs with no signup in five countries, UDP only, auto-expiry after 7 days, and no port forwarding offered.

evidence.quote: Each configuration is valid for 7 days. After expiration, you will need to generate a new one.

evidence.proved: free with no account or signup
evidence.quote: Yes. The servers, config files and QR codes are free, with no account or signup.

evidence.proved: the service is an outbound exit; no inbound port is described
evidence.quote: Your traffic is encrypted between your device and our server. From there it travels to websites as normal, so keep using HTTPS sites for anything sensitive.

notes: Free commercial VPN provider providing WireGuard and OpenVPN client configurations. Operates as an outbound VPN exit gateway; inbound port forwarding is not supported.

extras.wg_detail: A genuine free WireGuard configuration with no account: Select a server, choose a port, and generate a unique WireGuard configuration. Each config expires after 7 days. Transport is UDP only.
extras.volume_stated: The page states no traffic allowance in either direction; it advertises no signup and no account, and is funded by ads and donations.
